system.name: CV Screener
system.intended_purpose: Rank applicants for software-engineering roles from their CVs and propose a shortlist. A recruiter reviews every shortlist before anyone is contacted or rejected.

requirements.obligation: Treat an AI system listed in Annex III as high-risk and apply Chapter III, Sections 2 and 3, unless the Art. 6(3) derogation (no significant risk of harm, narrow procedural or preparatory task, no profiling) applies and is documented.
Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system for the high-risk AI system, run as a continuous iterative process over the whole lifecycle.
Identify and analyse the known and reasonably foreseeable risks to health, safety or fundamental rights under intended use, and estimate and evaluate risks under reasonably foreseeable misuse.

Adopt risk management measures so that the residual risk of each hazard and the overall residual risk are judged acceptable: eliminate or reduce risks by design, mitigate the rest, and inform and train deployers.
Test the high-risk AI system to identify the most appropriate risk management measures and to ensure it performs consistently for its intended purpose and complies with Section 2.
Test during development and in any event before placing on the market, against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds appropriate to the intended purpose.

label.name: qualified
label.rule: years_experience >= 3 and education_level in ['bachelor', 'master', 'phd'] and skills_match >= 0.5

limitations: Synthetic only: realism is checked against the dictionary and stated population stats, not against real applicants.
Strata are balanced by design: group rates are not population rates.
Boundary-aware rows are chosen with a linear surrogate of the model; they over-represent near-threshold cases by design.

privacy.note: Surface fields come from Faker or curated synthetic lists only.

realism.note: Strata ['sex'] are balanced by design, so their marginals differ from the population.
realism.reference: 1000 rows sampled from the (fitted) dictionary alone (no strata, no transforms)

business_rules.note: Attribute-only and proxy-only twins may break rules on purpose (they change one field and keep the rest); they are not gated.

informativeness.note: Surrogate estimate; the real scores come from the execute step.
